subject: Demo extension request — AP approval delay
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novumhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap@novumhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Demo extension request — AP approval delay

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — our AP team is still routing the PO for the pilot (internal finance review ran longer than expected). Legal finished last week, but AP needs one more approval layer and has asked for supporting cost justification. We expect the PO to clear, but it's looking like it won't be in place before our sandbox access lapses next Wednesday.

Can Redwood hold the demo environment open for an additional 10 calendar days while AP completes approval? If it helps, I'm attaching a preview of the PO and the internal approval email so you can see where it is in flight.

Why we need the extra time:
- We're mid-run on performance tests (LLM latency/throughput) and need the last 2 days of the evaluation window for a final integration test.
- The procurement delay is not budget-related — it's an approval workflow backlog.

If a short extension is possible, please let me know any terms (e.g., requirement to produce the PO by the end of the extension). Appreciate your help — this pilot is important for our Q1 rollout planning.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director, AI Platforms
Novum Health
[Attachment: Novum_PO_preview.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, AP Team <ap@novumhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 11:23:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Demo extension request — AP approval delay

Hi Liam — thanks for the context and for sending the PO preview. Sorry to hear AP is in a slow queue.

We can grant a temporary extension to keep your sandbox and test agents active while AP completes the workflow. Proposed terms:
- 10 calendar days extension (access preserved through 2026-11-17).
- You must submit the final PO or signed SOW by end of day 2026-11-17 for continuity beyond that date.
- If PO isn't received by 11/17 we'll automatically pause the environment; we can reopen within 48 hours of receiving the PO.

Ben and Monica — looping you in to confirm we can place this as an exception (no billing changes; just keep the environment live and add a short-term token top-up if needed). Ben, can you approve a 10-day safety window and attach the formal approval? Monica, please flag if CS needs to schedule the final integration support.

Liam — once Ben approves we'll send a short confirmation PDF that you can share with AP/Finance.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

Deliverables from Redwood:
- Formal approval PDF for Novum (attached).
- +50k token buffer added to the sandbox account (effective now).
- CS (Monica) will reach out to schedule a final integration check-in next week.

Liam — for AP accelerate: if your AP team can reply-all to this thread with an estimated PO submission date or the name of the approver, I can ping finance and try to expedite intake. If AP prefers, we can accept a scanned authorization email to satisfy the terms and prevent a hard pause.

Ben Carter
